_meta.description: Investment Manager schema for agreement drafting. This is a template only — never write data to this file.

legal_name.description: Full legal name exactly as registered with ABN lookup

abn.description: Australian Business Number — 11 digits formatted as XX XXX XXX XXX

street_address.description: Full street address as a single line

postal_address.description: Full postal address as a single line. Populate only if different from street address.

telephone.description: Primary office telephone number including area code

email_invoices.description: Accounts payable / invoice recipient email address

corporate_structure.description: Overview of the investment manager's business structure. Include any corporate authorised representatives or other relevant entities different to the AFSL holder involved in the management or construction of the portfolio.

afsl_holder.description: Name of the entity holding the AFSL

corporate_authorised_representatives.description: List any CARs operating under the AFSL

other_relevant_entities.description: Any other entities involved in portfolio management or construction that are not the AFSL holder or a CAR

about.description: Overview of the investment manager for disclosure purposes. Must not include quantitative data that may go out of date quickly (e.g. FUM, AUM, number of clients, years in operation as a number). Focus on qualitative business description, heritage, and capabilities.

investment_philosophy_and_process.description: Description of the investment philosophy and process for disclosure purposes. Must not include quantitative data that may go out of date quickly. Focus on qualitative approach, beliefs, and methodology.

capacity.description: Qualitative or quantitative description of the strategy's capacity. May include hard or soft capacity limits.

fum.description: Funds under management for this specific strategy. Record as at date must be provided. This field is expected to be updated frequently.
